explanation: The statement says that v belongs to a Laurent piece. Laurent pieces are rational subsets of the adic spectrum `spa`, and `laurentPiece`, `spa` and `Spv` are all defined in the library itself (TauCeti). Mathlib has no Laurent pieces or rational subsets of adic spectra. The proof only unfolds the membership and uses `ValuativeRel.vle_total`, which is generic glue and not the theorem's content. So no Mathlib declaration carries this result.
